bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears used Caleb Williams' late game-winning drive to survive a wild 27-24 walk-off kick win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers despite Williams throwing a career-high four interceptions , a result that pushed Chicago into sole possession of first place in the NFC North following Minnesota's loss to Buffalo . Off the field, a coalition unveiled a major new stadium proposal, as a group led by Capri Investment Group and GRIT Chicago revealed a $10 billion "Bronzeville Lakefront" master plan anchored by a 75,000-seat domed stadium as the Bears continue weighing their long-term stadium options.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions continue preparations for their Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots in Germany, with the team using a notably tough stretch of games as preparation and reviewing film from their win over Miami. ESPN also graded the Lions' trade of Andre Cisco with the New York Jets , as the team looks to integrate the newly acquired safety into their defense ahead of the Munich matchup.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story centers on the Packers' Week 10 matchup against the Vikings, with head coach Matt LaFleur expecting Kirk Cousins to start for the Minnesota Vikings in Sunday's NFC North showdown , while Green Bay deals with a significant injury report and the continued buildup to Micah Parsons' potential return. Quarterback Jordan Love continues his strong season after being named NFC Offensive Player of the Week , even as the Packers navigate a thin backfield following Josh Jacobs being expected to miss 2-to-3 weeks due to a broken right ring finger .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings brought back quarterback Kirk Cousins via trade from the Raiders, and he addressed the media Wednesday at TCO Performance Center, saying he was "grateful to be back" as the team preps him to possibly start against Green Bay.
